meta.note: Manual evidence-class corrections. Entries here override the automated result of scripts/classify_evidence_classes.py; each carries the reason a reviewer disagreed with the heuristic. Add entries as {"id", "evidence_class", "note"}; IDs must exist in the curated catalog.
meta.review_pass: 2026-11-01: narrowed Class 0 to full software reconstruction cases; six partial case studies moved to Class 1.
meta.policy: Whole-product reconstructions with a real demo (non-branding raster screenshot, video or playable link) count as Class 0; logos, badges, SVG progress charts and chat invitations do not count as demos, so such entries stay at the evidence-based class.
